title: *CS409 GDB SOLUTION*
text:
*CS409 GDB SOLUTION* 

Recommendation: Option B (remote backup in another geographical region)

Answer:

The DBA should recommend Option B. Management requires recovery to the latest nightly backup even if all office equipment is destroyed, and a backup stored on a disk inside the same office (Option A) would be lost in the same flood that destroys the servers, so it fails the core requirement. Option B keeps the backup outside the flooded area, which makes it the only option that guarantees the backup survives a site-level disaster.

On recovery time, Option A is faster, but speed is irrelevant if the backup no longer exists. Option B restores more slowly, yet the scenario states it still meets the one-working-day deadline, so it satisfies the requirement. On internet dependency, Option B needs a connection to restore, but the company has reliable internet and replacement infrastructure is available, so this risk is acceptable and manageable. Therefore, backup safety is the deciding factor, and Option B is the correct choice.
